summary: Program 4's two pause permits, signed by the MPC network during the 2026-11-04 run, waited three days for an EVM relayer key in the services. With a funded key the services' permit relayer sent both on 2026-11-07, and Acme Lend v1's guard is paused on Sepolia and Base Sepolia.

program.name: Acme Lend v1 — pre-launch (testnet)
program.note: our own deliberately vulnerable fixture; tokens have no value

relayer.service: antibody-services all (the permit relayer, with RELAYER_EVM_KEY)
relayer.note: relaying is permissionless: the adapter checks the MPC signature, the deadline and the replay key; the relayer pays its own gas and is trusted for nothing

permits.fee_note: the L2 execution fee plus the OP Stack L1 data fee

not_sent.reason: already used on their adapters (applied during the 2026-11-04 run): the node's gas estimate reverted, so the relayer marked them refused and sent nothing, spending no gas

checks: https://antibody-three.vercel.app/status   # the API's /v1/status: no pending permit, no relayer alert
